about: The golden cases of section 9 of the build spec, written and hashed before the first run (eval/golden.lock.json). Cases 1 to 10 have an expected label. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected answer, written before the first run, run once, never used to tune the prompt. The earlier text A is always TEXT 1.
reference: A weekly newsletter that turns each governance vote into plain language and adds a table of how the ten largest holders voted, with a note when a holder voted against their usual side.

cases.later: Every Friday we explain the week's protocol votes simply, and show how the top ten token holders voted, flagging anyone who broke from their own pattern.
